purpose: Price and cost-estimation support. Never selects, ranks or recommends a pesticide.
price_date_policy: None of the retail page snapshots shows an observation date. price_date is therefore null and date_verified (2026-10-31) is the date the snapshot was retrieved. No price is described as current beyond that. Sellers: BigHaat, KisanShop, KisanCenter, IndustryBuying, FarmKey, Moglix, Plantix store, AgroStar (v1), ManaAgriMart (v1), AgriBegri (v1), Adhunik (v1).
normalization_policy: Solids to INR/kg, liquids to INR/L from the listed pack. Original pack, price, seller and URL are preserved. Representative value is the median of exact-formulation observations; brands are never merged into one claim.

estimate_grades.farmer_ready_range: exact formulation match, 3 or more usable observations, at least one medium-confidence source; show as an approximate range with date and "check your shop"
estimate_grades.indicative_only: formulation unspecified in the treatment KB, or fewer than 3 observations; show a price range at most, flagged indicative
estimate_grades.not_researched: no search was done in this pass

cost_rules: Cost is computed only when dose basis and price basis connect directly (g/L or ml/L gives cost per litre of spray; g/ha, ml/ha or kg/ha gives cost per hectare).
Percent-solution doses (potato blight list) are not converted; no water volume is ever assumed.
